verdict.rationale: Several independent community members describe Better Auth as open source, calling it 'the best open-source option' and 'better-auth (open source)', and contrast it with a 'closed-source cloud offering', which points to readable source code. No first-party evidence in the pack confirms this. missing for 10: first-party statement of the license (e.g. MIT) and its terms, a documented link to the public source repository, and hands-on confirmation that the full source is readable.
